name: BestMed
summary: Medication administration between pharmacies and nursing homes, started by four developers and three QAs. Eight years on the same system still ships monthly, from an offshore centre that grew to thirty-two.

name: Menlo Security
summary: The frontend of a multi-tenant platform run by banks, financial firms and the US Department of Defense. Four of us own the face of the product alongside teams in the US, UK and India, keeping production issues short-lived and the test coverage honest.

name: Soctrip
summary: The Social module of an ecosystem that also carries e-commerce and booking, on Java microservices behind several Angular applications. As assistant architect I held the contracts between modules, the migration plan and the review standard while the team grew past two hundred. The product is no longer under active development.

name: Zespri
summary: A decade-old ecosystem running kiwifruit from orchard growers through packhouses to market distribution. Joined as the only engineer on it, learned the business the slow way, then built the team that kept it moving — two or three months on site each open season.
